mission_10: You have completed the meta-learning chapter by implementing meta-learning techniques for NLP. Few-shot text classification with prototypical networks extends the image-based approach to text by representing documents as averaged word embeddings. Prompt-based classification leverages in-context learning, the remarkable ability of large language models to perform new tasks from a few demonstrations in the prompt. Cross-lingual transfer enables knowledge transfer across languages using word translation dictionaries, crucial for low-resource languages. Language model adaptation shows how MAML-style optimization can fine-tune pre-trained models for new NLP tasks with minimal data. These techniques address the fundamental challenge of NLP: the long tail of languages, domains, and tasks where labeled data is scarce. Meta-learning provides a principled framework for leveraging knowledge from data-rich tasks to solve data-poor ones, making AI more accessible across languages and domains.
